facts.text: Eleven method families were identified for creating virtual job sites; three were added to the eight named in the research question because they appear in off-road literature and behave differently from the original eight.
facts.quote: Eleven families were identified. The first eight are those named in the research question; the last three were added because they appear in the off-road literature and behave differently from the eight.

facts.text: Virtual job-site creation methods overlap in practice: a quarry model can combine a mine plan, a digital terrain model, drone photogrammetry for the active pit, terrestrial lidar around fixed plant, hand-built inaccessible areas, an asset library and procedural generation of hundreds of variants.
facts.quote: a quarry model might start from a mine plan and a digital terrain model, replace the active pit with a drone photogrammetry mesh, use terrestrial lidar around fixed plant, fill inaccessible areas by hand, populate the scene from an asset library

facts.text: For creating virtual job sites, the combination of creation methods matters more than the choice of any one authoring package.
facts.quote: That combination matters more than the choice of any one authoring package.

facts.text: Hand-built 3D site modelling uses artists or engineers to construct terrain, berms, trenches, buildings, conveyor structures, stockpiles and obstacles as explicit geometry in content-creation tools or game engines, using measurements, drawings, photographs and CAD references.
facts.quote: Artists or engineers build terrain, berms, trenches, buildings, conveyor structures, stockpiles and obstacles as explicit geometry in content-creation tools or game engines, from measurements, drawings, photographs and CAD references.

facts.text: Hand-built 3D models give objects clean semantic identities and collision surfaces, making the method ideal for targeted braking edge cases.
facts.quote: Everything has a clean semantic identity and a collision surface, which makes the method ideal for targeted braking edge cases

facts.text: Targeted braking edge cases suited to hand-built 3D models include a child-sized person partly behind a dump body, an object just outside a sensor field of view, a barrier at a crest and a truck approaching at a specified relative velocity.
facts.quote: a child-sized person partly behind a dump body, an object just outside a sensor field of view, a barrier at a crest, a truck approaching at a specified relative velocity.

facts.text: Throughput is a weakness of hand-built 3D site modelling.
facts.quote: Its weakness is throughput

facts.text: Hand-built 3D site models have an epistemic risk: visually convincing detail may reflect only one person's interpretation of a site, and undocumented assumptions can become accepted as truth.
facts.quote: a second, epistemic problem: visually convincing detail may only reflect how one person interpreted the site, and undocumented assumptions can become "truth".

facts.text: The Para-Lane authors describe hand-built synthetic scenes as requiring meticulous adjustments for artistic and coherent shading; this is on-road evidence.
facts.quote: The Para-Lane authors describe hand-built synthetic scenes as needing "meticulous adjustments for artistic and coherent shading"

facts.text: The Para-Lane authors call the process of building synthetic scenes by hand expensive; this is on-road evidence.
facts.quote: The Para-Lane authors describe hand-built synthetic scenes as needing "meticulous adjustments for artistic and coherent shading" and call the process "expensive".

facts.text: No independent benchmark of per-site manual modelling effort was found.
facts.quote: No independent benchmark of per-site manual modelling effort was found.

facts.text: Rule-based procedural generation uses scripts or a generative grammar to place terrain, benches, ramps, roads, berms, stockpiles, vegetation, structures, clutter, machines and people according to parameter ranges.
facts.quote: Scripts or a generative grammar place terrain, benches, ramps, roads, berms, stockpiles, vegetation, structures, clutter, machines and people according to parameter ranges

facts.text: Procedural virtual-site generation parameters include pit width and depth, ramp curvature, bench height, stockpile distribution, road roughness, vegetation density, object populations and materials.
facts.quote: (pit width and depth, ramp curvature, bench height, stockpile distribution, road roughness, vegetation density, object populations, materials).

facts.text: MAVS from Mississippi State University automatically generates new off-road terrain with controllable roughness, ecosystem, haze and moonlight.
facts.quote: MAVS (Mississippi State University) automatically generates new off-road terrain with controllable roughness, ecosystem, haze and moonlight.

facts.text: CropCraft, identified as an open-source Blender and Python tool dated November 2025, generates agricultural fields.
facts.quote: CropCraft (Blender and Python, open source, November 2025) generates agricultural fields.

facts.text: AgriGen, identified with Isaac Sim and dated September 2026, generates large agricultural scenes.
facts.quote: AgriGen (Isaac Sim, September 2026) generates large agricultural scenes.

facts.text: A 2023 paper in Automation in Construction procedurally scripts Blender construction scenes using real lighting captured on two dates.
facts.quote: A 2023 paper in Automation in Construction scripts Blender construction scenes procedurally with real lighting captured on two dates.

facts.text: A 2026 SAE technical paper describes a Unity-based off-road digital-twin simulator with procedural terrain, multiple cameras, lidar, GPS and IMU, dynamic weather and light, and failure annotations.
facts.quote: A 2026 SAE technical paper describes a Unity-based off-road digital-twin simulator with procedural terrain, multiple cameras, lidar, GPS and IMU, dynamic weather and light, and failure annotations.

facts.text: According to a 2026 overview paper labelled as vendor evidence, Isaac Sim Replicator provides programmable domain randomisation of pose, scale, lighting and material appearance.
facts.quote: Isaac Sim Replicator provides programmable domain randomisation of pose, scale, lighting and material appearance (2026 overview paper).

facts.text: A critical model-risk limitation of procedural site generation is that apparently broad parameter ranges are worthless if the generation rules omit the real failure-generating structure.
facts.quote: Its critical limitation is model risk: parameter ranges that look broad are worthless if the rules omit the real failure-generating structure

facts.text: Procedural scenes can create implausible combinations while missing correlations and rare structures that nobody encoded.
facts.quote: procedural scenes can create implausible combinations while missing correlations and rare structures that nobody encoded.
